note: Dated events that could move the estimates. "Target" means a company or government goal, not a fixed date.

events.title: OpenAI's token-based GSA OneGov deal starts (to Dec 31, 2028); Anthropic's $1 Claude deal extended to Oct 31, Google's Gemini deal to Nov 15
OpenAI resumed frontier RL training and internal inference on Oct 1, "11 days after our pause began", and says frontier training now runs with no internet access (OpenAI, post of Oct 23)
events.why: OpenAI's "11 days" puts the start of the pause at Sept 20, the day of the DNS incident; press reports at the time dated it Sept 25.
events.short: OpenAI resumed frontier training and internal inference (disclosed Oct 23)

events.title: New York City Council Committee of the Whole hearing: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and Meta testify under oath on AI risks and the Council's proposed bills; SpaceXAI was subpoenaed on Sept 28 after it did not respond
events.why: Sworn testimony is a forced-disclosure channel for agent incidents.

events.title: OpenAI's chief strategy officer Jason Kwon appears before the Australian Parliament's Joint Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence in Sydney on the June Medicare Statistics breach (an OpenAI spokesperson to AAP and Reuters, Sept 28); Anthropic is reported to send an envoy (Sydney Morning Herald, via AAP)
UK Commons Business, Innovation, Science and Trade Committee questions former OpenAI and Anthropic researchers, senior policy staff from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Google DeepMind, and UK officials
events.why: Public questioning on rogue models, testers' access, who can stop a release and mandatory reporting of problems is a disclosure channel.
events.short: UK Commons committee questions senior policy staff from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Google DeepMind

events.title: Anthropic's reported pre-IPO investor day at its San Francisco headquarters (Bloomberg, Oct 1, people familiar; no public S-1 on EDGAR as of Oct 2)

The FTC sent civil investigative demands to Anthropic and OpenAI (an FTC spokesperson, via CBS News; CBS dates them Wednesday, Oct 14), seeking documents on safety incidents, privacy policies and safeguards (Axios, via CBS News)
events.why: Compulsory process is a forced-disclosure channel for agent incidents.
events.short: FTC sends civil investigative demands to Anthropic and OpenAI

events.title: TSMC's third-quarter 2026 earnings conference (14:00 Taiwan time, late Oct 14 Pacific)
events.why: Chip-supply figures are a check on the compute spending behind our money gauge.
events.short: TSMC reports third-quarter 2026 results

events.title: Open weights released: Reflection AI's Beam on Hugging Face (Apache 2.0; technical report still listed as coming)
events.why: Open-weight releases widen what an unknown actor could run out of view.
events.short: Open weights released for Reflection AI's Beam

events.title: Anthropic files its IPO registration statement (Form S-1) publicly on SEC EDGAR, applying to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol "ANT"; the price range and share count are left blank
events.why: The S-1 is the first forced disclosure of Anthropic's figures and risk factors; it bears on our forecast anthropic-public-s1-by-nov15.
events.short: Anthropic files its S-1 publicly on SEC EDGAR (Nasdaq, symbol ANT)

events.title: Microsoft reports fiscal 2027 first-quarter results (July–September), including capital spending, after the market close; webcast 2:30 p.m. Pacific
events.why: Microsoft's capital spending is one of the four hyperscaler inputs to our money gauge.
events.short: Microsoft reports July–September results, including capital spending

events.title: Amazon reports third-quarter 2026 results, including capital spending; conference call 2:00 p.m. Pacific
events.why: Amazon's capital spending is one of the four hyperscaler inputs to our money gauge and to our forecast big4-q3-capex-600b-ttm.
events.short: Amazon reports July–September results, including capital spending

events.title: Open weights released: Mistral Large 4 on Hugging Face (Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License)
events.why: Open-weight releases widen what an unknown actor could run out of view.
events.short: Open weights released for Mistral Large 4

events.title: Forecast deadline: OpenAI says it has resumed training its frontier models (openai-resume-by-oct31)
Forecast deadline: Anthropic shares begin trading on Nasdaq (anthropic-ipo-by-oct31); Bloomberg (Oct 1) reported IPO marketing could start as soon as the week of Nov 9
US midterms; Reuters (Sept 28) reported Anthropic's IPO is likely after them; a public S-1 must appear at least 15 days before the roadshow
events.why: Public-company disclosure rules become a forced-disclosure channel.

events.title: Open weights due for Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro ("The full model weights will be released by Nov 4", Moonshot's launch blog; so far only on Kimi's own apps and API; license not stated)
events.why: Open-weight releases widen what an unknown actor could run out of view.
events.short: Open weights due for Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro

events.title: PCAST meets (virtual, 9–10 a.m. Pacific) with "Charges to the Board" on its tentative agenda; the Federal Register notice says PCAST "also provides advice in response to requests from the Super Intelligence Task Force"
events.short: PCAST meets; it advises the Super Intelligence Task Force

events.title: Alarm condition W2 is met unless OpenAI's post-Astra model (acknowledged Sept 8) is released or an external evaluation of it is announced first
events.short: Alarm condition W2 is met unless OpenAI's post-Astra model is released or externally evaluated

events.title: Forecast deadline: OpenAI releases its post-Astra model, or an external evaluation of it is publicly announced (openai-postastra-eval-or-release-by-nov7)

Anthropic's IPO roadshow is reported for the week of Nov 9: Bloomberg (Oct 1) said formal marketing could start as soon as that week, putting trading before Thanksgiving, Nov 26; Reuters (Oct 22, via Asia Business Daily) reported Nov 9 or that week, and IFR a Nov 9 launch with pricing the following week (people familiar in each)
events.why: Public-company disclosure rules become a forced-disclosure channel. With the S-1 public on Oct 26, the SEC staff's condition for confidential draft review, that the registration statement be filed publicly "at least 15 days prior to any road show", allows a roadshow from Nov 10 at the earliest (our inference).
events.short: Anthropic's reported IPO roadshow start; pricing reported for the following week

events.title: BIS's one-year suspension of its rule expanding end-user controls to cover affiliates of certain listed entities ends, absent an extension (none in the Federal Register as of Oct 30)
events.why: Ending the suspension would widen export restrictions to affiliates of listed firms, a further limit on chips reaching them (our inference).
events.short: BIS's suspension of its affiliates rule ends, absent an extension

events.title: Due: Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceXSI are asked to list their identified incidents of model misalignment (attempted or successful unsanctioned access to their internal networks, the internet or third-party networks) and of safeguard circumvention, for the top Democrats on three House committees (Pallone, Lofgren, Raskin), and to report new ones within 48 hours (letters of Oct 27; a request, not a legal duty)
events.why: Answers, if made public, would be a new disclosure channel for the incidents behind our oversight gauge.
events.short: Due: five AI labs' incident lists requested by House Democrats

events.title: Forecast deadline: Anthropic's IPO registration statement (S-1 or equivalent) is publicly filed on SEC EDGAR (anthropic-public-s1-by-nov15)
Forecast deadline: Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta report July–September capex of $186.57B or more on EDGAR (big4-q3-capex-600b-ttm)

Comments due on China's proposal to add 40 technologies, 23 of them AI (large models, agents, computing clusters, information processing), to its Catalogue of Technologies Prohibited or Restricted from Export (MOFCOM and MOST Announcement No. 48 of 2026)
events.short: Comments due on China's proposed export controls on 23 AI technologies

events.title: Due: agency recommendations to the Governor on AI-law changes, including a frontier-model kill-switch requirement (EO N-9-26 §3)
Anthropic's reported target for listing on Nasdaq (symbol ANT, per its S-1): the week of Nov 16, though the timing could change (people familiar, via the Wall Street Journal, read on Investing.com)
events.why: Trading would bear on our forecasts anthropic-trading-by-nov20 and anthropic-trading-by-nov30 and bring Anthropic under quarterly public-company reporting.
events.short: Anthropic's reported Nasdaq listing target (people familiar, via WSJ)

events.title: Nvidia reports third-quarter fiscal 2027 results (quarter ended Oct 25); conference call 2 p.m. Pacific
events.why: Nvidia's data-center sales are the supply side of the AI spending our money gauge tracks, and Jensen Huang made an AGI claim on the previous call (Aug 26; see the AGI claims page).
events.short: Nvidia reports quarterly results (quarter ended Oct 25)

events.title: Xi–Trump meeting expected at the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen (Nov 18–19, APEC); US and Chinese teams reportedly aim for a basic framework for AI-related crises by then, and the AI dialogue's next meeting is also set for November (anonymous sources, via SCMP, read in The Star)
events.short: US–China AI crisis framework targeted for Xi–Trump meeting at APEC Shenzhen

events.title: Forecast deadline: Anthropic shares begin trading on a US stock exchange (anthropic-trading-by-nov20)
Due: the President's science adviser submits proposed legislative language for a federal definition of "Super Intelligence" (EO of Sept 29, Sec. 3(b); internal submission)
events.why: For now the order defines SI as the existing statutory definition of AI (15 U.S.C. 9401(3)); a new definition would be a label, not a capability finding.

events.title: Forecast deadlines: Gemini 4 public or paid preview (gemini4-by-nov30); METR time-horizon estimate for GPT-6 Astra (metr-astra-horizon-by-nov30); California publishes the EO N-9-26 recommendations (ca-eo-n926-recs-published-by-nov30); Anthropic shares begin trading on a US stock exchange (anthropic-trading-by-nov30)

Comments due on Treasury's proposed Outbound Investment Security Program rule under the COINS Act, which renames AI systems "super intelligence systems" and would make developing any SI system a prohibited technology for US-person investment in covered foreign persons (Docket TREAS-DO-2026-0595; Federal Register publication Oct 26)
events.why: Treasury drops compute thresholds, saying "no single measure, benchmark, or threshold is currently sufficient to distinguish advanced models".
events.short: Comments due on Treasury's proposed outbound-investment rule covering "super intelligence systems"

events.title: Alarm condition W6 is met unless OpenAI's post-Astra model is released or its capabilities are published first (90 days of internal use from Sept 8, skipping OpenAI's pause from Sept 25 to Oct 1; three other readings are flagged for the owner: counting from OpenAI's Oct 23 announcement (Jan 4, 2027), voiding the pause for red-teaming (Dec 7), or excluding Sept 20–24 as well (Dec 18))
events.short: W6 is met unless OpenAI's post-Astra model is released or its capabilities published

events.title: Forecast deadline: OpenAI releases a model it says is more capable overall than GPT-6 Astra, or publishes capability scores for its unreleased post-Astra model (openai-beyond-astra-or-capabilities-by-dec13)
Gemini 4 Argon wider release: limited to trusted cyber defenders (Fairwind Program) since Sept 30; paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers come next
events.why: Google says the wider release comes "as soon as possible"; Google DeepMind's Koray Kavukcuoglu said in the week of Sept 21 that he hoped for well before year-end.

events.title: Altman's stated target: an internal OpenAI system he would call AGI (TIME, Aug 26)
events.why: He said OpenAI is "not quite yet" there; internal-but-unannounced is the gap Hypothesis A measures.

events.title: Australia's national AI standards due by year-end, legislation planned for 2027 (ABC, Oct 8); a duty to report rogue-AI incidents is proposed (ABC, Sept 29)
events.why: A second mandatory incident-reporting channel, outside the US, prompted by the Medicare breach.
events.short: Australia's national AI standards due; legislation planned for 2027

events.title: Forecast deadline: xAI releases Grok 5 (grok5-by-dec31)
Forecast deadline: Anthropic publishes a new reading of Anthropic's AI-led R&D share, for September 2026 or later (anthropic-rd-index-new-reading-by-dec31)
Forecast deadline: OpenAI announces it has achieved AGI (openai-agi-announce-by-dec31)

Forecast deadline: Anthropic releases a model it says is more capable than Claude Mythos 5.1, or an outside evaluation of such an unreleased Anthropic model is announced (anthropic-beyond-mythos51-release-or-eval-by-dec31)
New York RAISE Act takes effect (72-hour incident reporting)
Forecast deadline: an AI system scores 25% or more on Scale AI's Remote Labor Index (rli-25pct-by-jan31)
Forecast deadline: OpenAI releases a model it says is more capable overall than GPT-6 Astra (openai-beyond-astra-release-by-jan31)
Forecast deadline: Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta report October–December capex of $203.28B or more on EDGAR (big4-q4-capex-700b-ttm)
Forecast deadline: a major lab formally declares it has achieved AGI (agi-declared-by-mar31)
Forecast deadline: a peer-reviewed journal accepts OpenAI's Navier–Stokes paper for publication (navier-journal-by-sep30-2027)
Pentagon's target date to establish a four-star Autonomous Warfare Command to scale autonomous and robotic systems (announced Sept 30; needs legislation from Congress)
OpenAI's target for an automated AI researcher

undated.title: OpenAI's Navier–Stokes proof: journal submission or independent verification

FTC subpoenas to third-party organizations in its AI safety-incidents probe, which it "will also issue … at a later date" (a person familiar, via Axios, via CBS News); earlier reports named METR as a possible target
OpenAI announces its contracts with third-party safety assessors (on Oct 8 it said it is "actively finalizing" them, with details "in the coming weeks")
New Mexico's planned Frontier Artificial Intelligence Safety and Accountability Act (24-hour loss-of-control incident reporting) is introduced in the January 2027 legislative session

D.C. Circuit rules on Anthropic's petition for panel rehearing or rehearing en banc of its decision on the Pentagon's supply-chain-risk designation (Anthropic PBC v. U.S. Department of War, No. 26-1049)

Gemini 4 Carbon wider release to developers, businesses and consumers (Google, Oct 28: "a subset of cyber defenders" first, "starting this week", then more trusted partners through the Fairwind Program; wider release "as soon as possible")
